pass_condition: All expected eBird products are listed with filenames sizes and product roles
stop_rule: Stop if expected product identity is unclear
notes: No raw rows opened before inventory is recorded

pass_condition: Request ID submission date approved purpose and analyst initials are recorded
stop_rule: Stop if request identity or purpose cannot be tied to delivery

pass_condition: eBird terms citation version and redistribution limits are recorded or pointed to
stop_rule: Stop if terms or citation obligations are unclear
notes: Restricted terms text may be stored outside Git

pass_condition: Raw files are under data/ebird_raw or data/ebird_quarantine and absent from tracked paths
stop_rule: Stop if raw delivery is in Git or outside approved ignored roots

pass_condition: SHA-256 checksums are recorded and stable before parsing
stop_rule: Stop if checksums change without documented replacement
notes: Checksums may be committed without rows

pass_condition: EBD observation and sampling-event metadata products are present and distinguishable
stop_rule: Stop if sampling-event metadata are missing
notes: Header inspection occurs only after quarantine and terms gates

pass_condition: Observation records can join to checklist or sampling-event metadata by stable event keys
stop_rule: Stop if event joins are unavailable

pass_condition: Complete-checklist status or equivalent checklist completeness field is available
stop_rule: Stop if completeness cannot be identified
notes: Incomplete records cannot support absence inference

pass_condition: Duration protocol distance or applicable effort fields and party size or observer count are available
stop_rule: Stop if effort metadata cannot support observation modelling

pass_condition: Sensitive hidden private or spatial-generalisation indicators are available where supplied
stop_rule: Stop if restrictions cannot be detected or respected
notes: Support assignment must respect provider restrictions

pass_condition: Records can be filtered to 2018-01-01 through 2024-12-31 before linkage
stop_rule: Stop if dates are absent or unparseable

pass_condition: Locations or approved precision fields can support documented assignment to Goal 020 supports or privacy buckets
stop_rule: Stop if support assignment would expose restricted precision
notes: No new geometry workflow in Goal 023

pass_condition: Core design can restrict to core_eligible and core_eligible_with_caveat and retain sensitivity_only for accounting
stop_rule: Stop if hydrology readiness classes are missing

pass_condition: Shared checklists and duplicate submissions can be identified or conservatively handled
stop_rule: Stop if duplicates cannot be audited

pass_condition: No raw records private responses credentials screenshots archives rasters or stores are tracked
stop_rule: Stop release if blocked file types or raw paths are tracked

pass_condition: Any future derived table includes request ID data version terms citation support assignment and QA status
stop_rule: Warn if metadata columns are incomplete

pass_condition: Aggregated outputs are reviewed against eBird terms before external sharing
stop_rule: Do not externally share until review is recorded
